name: @analyzr/integrate
description: Sources and tests of the scripts of the Claude Code plugin plugins/analyzr-integrate (M6 §3.7): inspect, normalize-bpmn, the read-only analyzr-read, analyzr-spec (renderer), analyzr-convert (converter runner) and analyzr-interview (interview guide, M6 S6), bundled with the CLI's plugin entry (apps/cli/src/plugin-main.ts, as analyzr.mjs) into self-contained plugins/analyzr-integrate/scripts/*.mjs, and of the plugin's skill texts and the Claude Desktop start prompts (sources in skills/), all written by `pnpm --filter @analyzr/integrate generate`; imported by nothing in apps/ or packages/
